metadata.title: Stocks to Watch: ON Semiconductor, Apple, Zalando

content.text:
LIVE
Updated 16 min ago
Stocks to Watch: ON Semiconductor, Apple, Zalando
↘️ ON Semiconductor (ON): The chip maker agreed to acquire Synaptics (SYNA) in a roughly $7 billion all-stock transaction, as it seeks to push into physical AI. Shares of ON Semiconductor tumbled 19%, while Synaptics’ stock fell 2%.
↘️ Micron Technology (MU), Sandisk (SNDK), Seagate Technology (STX): Chip stocks and memory makers lost ground, putting them on track to give up gains made yesterday after Micron reported blockbuster quarterly results.
↗️ Apple (AAPL): Shares of the iPhone maker ticked higher. The stock slid more than 6% yesterday after the company raised the prices of its Macs and iPads.
